items.title: Support all documented query hints
items.body:
This emulator validates names and values of query hints.
It is useful to ensure that the query is valid, but sometimes, valid queries can be rejected because of unimplemented hints.

Ideally, all valid queries with hints should be accepted.


## Current status (as of 2025-12-05)

[Statement Hints](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax#statement_hints)

|hint name| supported|
|---|---|
|`USE_ADDITIONAL_PARALLELISM`|Yes|
|`OPTIMIZER_VERSION`|No|
|`OPTIMIZER_STATISTICS_PACKAGE`|No|
|`ALLOW_DISTRIBUTED_MERGE`|No|
|`LOCK_SCANNED_RANGES	`|Yes|
|`SCAN_METHOD`|Yes|
|`EXECUTION_METHOD`|No|
|`USE_UNENFORCED_FOREIGN_KEY`|No|
|`ALLOW_TIMESTAMP_PREDICATE_PUSHDOWN`|No|

```
spanner> @{OPTIMIZER_VERSION=latest} SELECT 1;
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: Unsupported hint: OPTIMIZER_VERSION.

spanner> @{OPTIMIZER_STATISTICS_PACKAGE=latest} SELECT 1;
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: Unsupported hint: OPTIMIZER_STATISTICS_PACKAGE.

spanner> @{ALLOW_DISTRIBUTED_MERGE=TRUE} SELECT 1;
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: Unsupported hint: ALLOW_DISTRIBUTED_MERGE.

spanner> @{EXECUTION_METHOD=BATCH} SELECT 1;
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: Unsupported hint: EXECUTION_METHOD.

spanner> @{USE_UNENFORCED_FOREIGN_KEY=TRUE} SELECT 1;
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: Unsupported hint: USE_UNENFORCED_FOREIGN_KEY.

spanner> @{ALLOW_TIMESTAMP_PREDICATE_PUSHDOWN=TRUE} SELECT 1;
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: Unsupported hint: ALLOW_TIMESTAMP_PREDICATE_PUSHDOWN.
```

[Table hints](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax#table_hints)

|hint name| supported|
|---|---|
|`FORCE_INDEX`|Yes|
|`GROUPBY_SCAN_OPTIMIZATION`|Yes|
|`SCAN_METHOD`|Yes|
|`INDEX_STRATEGY`|Yes|
|`SEEKABLE_KEY_SIZE`|No|

```
spanner> SELECT * FROM Singers@{FORCE_INDEX=SingersByFirstLastName,SEEKABLE_KEY_SIZE=1};
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: Unsupported hint: SEEKABLE_KEY_SIZE.
```

[Join hints](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax#join_hints)

|hint name| supported|
|---|---|
|`FORCE_JOIN_ORDER`|Yes|
|`JOIN_METHOD`|Yes|
|`HASH_JOIN_BUILD_SIDE`|Yes, but only accepted using `HASH JOIN` (not `@{JOIN_METHOD=HASH_JOIN}`)|
|`BATCH_MODE`|No|
|`HASH_JOIN_EXECUTION`|Yes|

```
### HASH_JOIN_BUILD_SIDE with HASH JOIN
spanner> SELECT * FROM Singers HASH JOIN@{HASH_JOIN_BUILD_SIDE=BUILD_LEFT} Albums USING (SingerId);
+----------+-----------+----------+------------+------------+---------+-------------------------+-----------------+
| SingerId | FirstName | LastName | SingerInfo | BirthDate  | AlbumId | AlbumTitle              | MarketingBudget |
| INT64    | STRING    | STRING   | BYTES      | DATE       | INT64   | STRING                  | INT64           |
+----------+-----------+----------+------------+------------+---------+-------------------------+-----------------+
| 2        | Catalina  | Smith    | NULL       | 1990-08-17 | 1       | Green                   | NULL            |
| 4        | Lea       | Martin   | NULL       | 1991-11-09 | 1       | Play                    | NULL            |
| 1        | Marc      | Richards | NULL       | 1970-09-03 | 1       | Total Junk              | NULL            |
| 2        | Catalina  | Smith    | NULL       | 1990-08-17 | 2       | Forever Hold Your Peace | NULL            |
| 2        | Catalina  | Smith    | NULL       | 1990-08-17 | 3       | Terrified               | NULL            |
| 1        | Marc      | Richards | NULL       | 1970-09-03 | 2       | Go, Go, Go              | NULL            |
| 3        | Alice     | Trentor  | NULL       | 1991-10-02 | 1       | Nothing To Do With Me   | NULL            |
+----------+-----------+----------+------------+------------+---------+-------------------------+-----------------+
7 rows in set (1.61051ms)

### HASH_JOIN_BUILD_SIDE with JOIN_METHOD=HASH_JOIN
spanner> SELECT * FROM Singers JOIN@{JOIN_METHOD=HASH_JOIN,HASH_JOIN_BUILD_SIDE=BUILD_LEFT} Albums USING (SingerId);
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: hash_join_build_side hint is only supported for HASH joins.

spanner> SELECT * FROM Singers JOIN@{BATCH_MODE=TRUE} Albums USING (SingerId);
ERROR: spanner: code="InvalidArgument", desc: Unsupported hint: BATCH_MODE.
```

items.title: EmulatorFeatureFlags::flags() returns guarded state after releasing its lock
Internal error on generated columns
items.body:
I've tried following the sharding patterns described in [this blog](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/gcp/sharding-of-timestamp-ordered-data-in-cloud-spanner) post and [the documentation](https://cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/schema-design#fix_hash_the_key).
While experimenting, I came across two issues.

### Invalid generated column being accepted by the emulator

This DDL should not be accepted by the emulator, as the production Spanner API rejects it:

```sql
CREATE TABLE Entity (
  id STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,
  leaseExpiration TIMESTAMP,
  -- NOT NULL is not allowed here.
  shard INT64 NOT NULL AS (MOD(ABS(FARM_FINGERPRINT(id)), 20)),
) PRIMARY KEY (id);
CREATE INDEX EntitiesByShardAndLeaseExpiration ON Entity(shard, leaseExpiration)
```

The production API returns the following error: `Generated column 'Entity.shard' that are not marked as STORED cannot be specified as NOT NULL.`.

### Internal error when querying an index on the generated column

Independently of whether the generated column is marked as `NON NULL` or not, an error is sometimes returned by the emulator when querying the index on the `shard` column. For example when running the following query:

```sql
UPDATE
  Entity
SET
  leaseExpiration = TIMESTAMP_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
WHERE
  id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM
      Entity@{FORCE_INDEX=EntitiesByShardAndLeaseExpiration}
    WHERE
      shard BETWEEN 0 AND 19
      AND (
        leaseExpiration IS NULL
        OR leaseExpiration < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
      )
    LIMIT
      5
  )
THEN RETURN
  id,
  leaseExpiration
```

The result is sometimes `{"code":5, "message":"Failed to find column: Entity.id#4"}`.
In other tests (not the minimal reproducible example), I even got a `13: INTERNAL` error. In the emulator logs corresponding to the internal error, there was a link to [this assert](https://github.com/google/zetasql/blob/a516c6b26d183efc4f56293256bba92e243b7a61/zetasql/reference_impl/value_expr.cc#L2299).

I'll provide `gcloud` commands to reproduce the bug in the first comment.

items.title: Memory Leak + Performance Decrease per Connection
Cloud Spanner Emulator version 1.4.1 (linux binary) no longer works on CentOS Stream 8
items.body:
### Summary
We are running CentOS Stream 8 in our environment.
Prior to the most recently released version, `1.4.1`, Spanner Emulator was running perfectly on CentOS 8.
Starting with `1.4.1` an attempt to run `gateway_main` on CentOS 8 results in an error:
```
/lib64/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.26' not found (required by /root/1.4.1/emulator_main)
2022/02/22 02:07:31 gateway.go:107: Shutting down gateway server since grpc server is terminated.
```

According to the documentation in this repository, it should work:
> Note that this binary is not fully static, but has been tested on Ubuntu 16.04/18.04, **CentOS 8, RHEL 8**, and Debian 9/10.

#### Possible root cause

It appears like the most recent version of binaries was built/linked on a machine with `GLIBCXX_3.4.26` support, with no hard linking to a specific GLIBCXX version. `GLIBCXX_3.4.26` symbols are supported as part of `libstdc++.so.6.0.26` binary which is part of the `GCC 9.1.0` ([source, GCC versioning documentation](https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/libstdc++/manual/abi.html)). CentOS 8/RHEL 8 is shipped with GCC 8 so binaries built for `GLIBCXX_3.4.26` are not going to work on CentOS 8/RHEL 8.

### Steps to reproduce
The easiest way to reproduce this issue would be to create a CentOS 8 docker container, download Spanner Emulator to it, and attempt to start it.

#### Dockerfile
I've defined the following `Dockerfile` which uses the official CentOS Stream 8 docker image and installs `wget` to download the emulator
```
FROM quay.io/centos/centos:stream

RUN yum install -y wget

ENTRYPOINT ["tail", "-f", "/dev/null"]
```

#### Preparing the test environment
To confirm that the issue is only present in the most recent version I'm going to run affected and unaffected versions on the same container.

To prepare the container I'm going to create two folders under `home` (one for `1.4.0` version and one for `1.4.1`), download two different versions of the emulator and unpack them to corresponding folders:
```
cd ~
mkdir 1.4.0
mkdir 1.4.1
wget https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-spanner-emulator/releases/1.4.0/cloud-spanner-emulator_linux_amd64-1.4.0.tar.gz
wget https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-spanner-emulator/releases/1.4.1/cloud-spanner-emulator_linux_amd64-1.4.1.tar.gz
tar zxvf cloud-spanner-emulator_linux_amd64-1.4.0.tar.gz -C ./1.4.0
tar zxvf cloud-spanner-emulator_linux_amd64-1.4.1.tar.gz -C ./1.4.1
```

#### Running emulator
First I'm going to run the `1.4.0` version to confirm that it works just fine:
```
./1.4.0/gateway_main --hostname 0.0.0.0
```
Output:
```
2022/02/22 02:07:07 gateway.go:140: Cloud Spanner emulator running.
2022/02/22 02:07:07 gateway.go:141: REST server listening at 0.0.0.0:9020
2022/02/22 02:07:07 gateway.go:142: gRPC server listening at 0.0.0.0:9010
```

Now I'm going to try and run the `1.4.1` version and see it fail:
```
./1.4.1/gateway_main --hostname 0.0.0.0
```
Output:
```
/root/1.4.1/emulator_main: /lib64/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.26' not found (required by /root/1.4.1/emulator_main)
2022/02/22 02:07:31 gateway.go:107: Shutting down gateway server since grpc server is terminated.
```
Here is a screenshot of this reproduction example:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/63533332/155052662-12806fa7-1b86-41a4-89c9-cb729e35c355.png)
